WITH ref AS (
  SELECT MAX(moved_at)::date AS max_date
  FROM inventory_movements
),
inv AS (
  SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS current_qty
  FROM inventory
  GROUP BY warehouse_id
),
outb AS (
  SELECT im.warehouse_id,
         SUM(im.quantity) AS outbound_qty
  FROM inventory_movements im
  CROSS JOIN ref r
  WHERE im.movement_type = '2'
    AND r.max_date IS NOT NULL
    AND im.moved_at >= r.max_date - INTERVAL '89 days'
    AND im.moved_at < r.max_date + INTERVAL '1 day'
  GROUP BY im.warehouse_id
)
SELECT w.warehouse_id,
       inv.current_qty AS current_inventory,
       CASE WHEN r.max_date IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE COALESCE(outb.outbound_qty, 0)
       END AS outbound_quantity_90d,
       CASE WHEN r.max_date IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN COALESCE(outb.outbound_qty, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(90.0 * inv.current_qty::numeric / outb.outbound_qty::numeric, 1)
       END AS inventory_turnover_days
FROM warehouses w
CROSS JOIN ref r
LEFT JOIN inv ON inv.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN outb ON outb.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY w.warehouse_id
LIMIT 1000;
